text: quality_report() aggregates metrics two-property hierarchy used SDMetrics — Column Shapes (per-column marginal fidelity) Column Pair Trends (correlation similarity numerical pairs, contingency similarity categorical pairs) — overall score mean two. diagnostic_report() complements structural-validity checks (value ranges, category adherence, key uniqueness), sample_conditions() generates rows hold given categorical values fixed:

title: rsdv 0.1.0
text: Gaussian copula synthesizer (gaussian_copula_synthesizer()) fits single joint copula modeled columns: numerical, categorical, boolean. Parametric marginal fitting numerical columns best-fit selection among norm, beta, gamma, truncnorm, uniform Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance. Per-column overrides via numerical_distributions; global default via default_distribution. Categorical boolean columns embedded copula via cumulative-frequency intervals, preserving cross-column dependence (numeric↔︎categorical categorical↔︎categorical). sample() unconditional generation sample_conditions() conditional generation categorical boolean values via rejection sampling. Per-column missingness rates training data reproduced synthetic output.

title: rsdv 0.1.0
text: Column-type metadata system (metadata(), set_column_type(), set_primary_key()) auto-detection JSON serialization (metadata_to_json(), save_metadata()). Declarative constraint system: equality, inequality, fixed-combinations, custom row-level predicates (add_constraint(), check_constraints()), enforced via rejection sampling.

title: rsdv 0.1.0
text: Column Shapes — per-column marginal fidelity (KS similarity numerical, TVD similarity categorical). Column Pair Trends — pairwise dependence (correlation_similarity() numerical pairs, contingency_similarity() categorical pairs). ML efficacy (train--synthetic / test--real, TSTR/TRTR) reported separately, folded overall score. diagnostic_report() checks structural validity: boundary adherence (numerical ranges), category adherence (categorical values), key uniqueness primary keys. privacy_report() reports nearest-neighbour distance ratio (NNDR) , optionally, attribute disclosure risk. autoplot() methods quality, diagnostic, privacy reports.
